objective_pt: Convidar alguém ("Would you like to...?", "How about...?"), aceitar ou recusar com educação e combinar dia, hora e lugar.

teacher.goal_pt: Introduzir o convite educado e as respostas "I'd love to" e "I'm afraid I can't".
prompts: Would you like to have a coffee after class?
When did someone last invite you to a party?
watchFor: Responder só "I'd love!"; o certo é "I'd love to!".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita o convite em voz alta.
exercises.prompt: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?
accepted: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "would you like" vem "to" + verbo: "Would you like to come?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual resposta aceita um convite com entusiasmo?
exercises.explanation_pt: "I'd love to" (eu adoraria) precisa do "to" no fim. "I love to" é "eu adoro fazer isso" em geral.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Você quer ir ao cinema hoje à noite?"
accepted: Do you want to go to the movies tonight?
Do you want to go to the cinema tonight?
Would you like to go to the movies tonight?
Would you like to go to the cinema tonight?
Do you wanna go to the movies tonight?
Want to go to the movies tonight?
How about going to the movies tonight?
Do you want to see a movie tonight?
Would you like to see a movie tonight?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Hoje à noite" é uma palavra só: "tonight".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to go to the movies tonight?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, comece com "Do": "Do you want to go...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to go to the movies tonight?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "want" vem "to": "want to go".
commonErrors.correction_en: Do you want to go to the movies tonight?

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender as expressões de convite e resposta: How about...?, I'd love to, I'm afraid I can't, maybe another time, I've got plans.
prompts: How do you say no politely?
What do you say if you're busy?
watchFor: "I have a compromise" (do "tenho um compromisso"); "compromise" é acordo com concessões. O certo é "I have plans" ou "I have an appointment".
"How about go...?"; depois de "How about" vem "-ing": "How about going...?".

exercises.example_en: How about having lunch together tomorrow?
Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't. I'm working.
Sorry, I'm busy tonight. Maybe another time?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada expressão ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "Desculpa, eu não posso. Eu tenho um compromisso."
accepted: Sorry, I can't. I have plans
Sorry, I can't. I've got plans
Sorry, I can't. I already have plans
Sorry, I can't. I have other plans
I'm sorry, I can't. I have plans
Sorry, I can't. I have something else
Sorry, I can't. I have an appointment
I'm afraid I can't. I have plans
Sorry, I can't make it. I have plans
Sorry, I can't. I'm busy

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "compromise" é um acordo em que cada lado cede. "Compromisso" é "plans" ou "an appointment".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, I can't. I have plans.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A negação de "can" é "can't" (cannot): "I can't".
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, I can't. I have plans.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para pedir desculpas ao recusar, use "Sorry". "Excuse me" é para chamar atenção ou pedir licença.
commonErrors.correction_en: Sorry, I can't. I have plans.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a ligação de "Would you" ("wú-dju") e a entonação que sobe no convite e desce na resposta.
prompts: Say "I'd love to!" with a happy voice.
watchFor: Separar "would" e "you" sem ligar os sons.
Recusar com voz seca; um tom mais suave ("Oh, I'm sorry...") soa mais educado.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Would you" se junta: "wú-dju". A voz sobe no fim da pergunta.
exercises.prompt: Would you like to join us for dinner?
accepted: Would you like to join us for dinner?

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita com uma voz gentil: primeiro agradeça, depois recuse.
exercises.prompt: Oh, thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't.
accepted: Oh, thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't
Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't
Oh, thank you for asking, but I'm afraid I can't

exercises.instruction_pt: Em "I can't", como você mostra que é negativo, se o "t" quase não aparece?
options: A vogal de "can't" é mais longa e forte: "kænt".
exercises.explanation_pt: "Can" na frase é curtinho e fraco ("kn"). "Can't" é forte, com a vogal aberta e longa.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender um convite com dia, hora e lugar e responder aceitando ou propondo outro horário.
prompts: What time is good for you?
watchFor: "I'm free in Friday"; dias da semana usam "on".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o convite e escolha o que foi combinado.
exercises.listen: We're having a barbecue at my place on Sunday. It starts at one. Can you bring some drinks?
options: Churrasco na casa dele no domingo à uma; levar bebidas.
Churrasco no parque no sábado às onze; levar carne.
Jantar na casa dele no domingo às sete; levar sobremesa.
exercises.explanation_pt: "At my place" é na casa dele, "on Sunday" é no domingo, "at one" é à uma, e "bring some drinks" é levar bebidas.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o convite e aceite com entusiasmo.
exercises.listen: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Friday?
accepted: I'd love to
Yes, I'd love to
I would love to
Yes, I'd love to. Thank you
Yes, I'd love to. Thanks for inviting me
I'd love to, thanks
Sure, I'd love to
Of course! I'd love to
Yes, of course
Yes, sure
That sounds great! I'd love to
Sounds great, I'd love to come
I'd love to come
Yes, I'd love to come

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I'd love" precisa do "to" no fim: "I'd love to!".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'd love to!

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I love to" é "eu adoro" (em geral). Para aceitar um convite, diga "I'd love to".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I'd love to!

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "With pleasure" existe, mas soa formal para um convite de amigo. "I'd love to!" é mais natural.
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, I'd love to!

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que no sábado você não pode, mas no domingo você está livre.
exercises.listen: Are you free on Saturday? Let's go hiking!
accepted: Sorry, I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday
I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday
Saturday is bad for me, but I'm free on Sunday
I'm busy on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday
Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday. How about Sunday?
I can't on Saturday. How about Sunday?
Not on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday
Sorry, I'm not free on Saturday, but Sunday is fine
Saturday doesn't work for me, but I'm free on Sunday
I'm afraid I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Dias da semana usam "on": "on Saturday", "on Sunday".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o verbo "to be": "I'm free".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A negação de "can" é "can't".
commonErrors.correction_en: I can't on Saturday, but I'm free on Sunday.

teacher.goal_pt: Convidar, negociar o horário e confirmar o plano numa conversa completa.
prompts: I'm having a party next week. Would you like to come?
What would you like to do this weekend?
watchFor: "Let's to go" com "to"; depois de "let's" vem o verbo direto.
"We meet where?" em vez de "Where should we meet?".
"How about go" em vez de "How about going".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Que tal a gente se encontrar às sete na frente do cinema?"
accepted: How about meeting at seven in front of the cinema?
How about meeting at 7 in front of the cinema?
How about we meet at seven in front of the cinema?
What about meeting at seven in front of the cinema?
Why don't we meet at seven in front of the cinema?
Let's meet at seven in front of the cinema
How about meeting at seven in front of the movie theater?
Shall we meet at seven in front of the cinema?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "How about" o verbo vem com "-ing": "How about meeting...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: How about meeting at seven in front of the cinema?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Que tal" é "How about...?" ou "What about...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: How about meeting at seven in front of the cinema?

commonErrors.match: \b(at the front of|on front of|in the front of)\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Na frente de" é "in front of".
commonErrors.correction_en: How about meeting at seven in front of the cinema?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Obrigado pelo convite! Vamos sim."
accepted: Thanks for the invitation! We'll be there
Thank you for the invitation! We'll be there
Thanks for inviting us! We'll be there
Thank you for inviting us! We'll come
Thanks for the invite! We'll be there
Thanks for the invitation! We'll definitely come
Thanks for inviting us! We'd love to come
Thank you for the invitation! We'll come

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Convite" é "invitation" (ou "invite", informal).
commonErrors.correction_en: Thanks for the invitation! We'll be there.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O "sim" de reforço não se traduz. Diga "We'll be there" ou "We'll definitely come".
commonErrors.correction_en: Thanks for the invitation! We'll be there.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Obrigado por" é "thanks for".
commonErrors.correction_en: Thanks for the invitation! We'll be there.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar o convite.
accepted: Let's go for a walk in the park

exercises.instruction_pt: Convide a Sam para fazer algo no fim de semana. Ela já tem um compromisso no sábado, então combinem outro dia.
exercises.prompt_en: Hey! It's so good to hear from you. I'm busy on Saturday, I've got plans with my family. But what did you want to ask me?
guidelines_pt: Faça o convite: "Would you like to...?" ou "How about...?".
Proponha outro dia e horário: "Are you free on Sunday?", "How about at four?".
Combine o lugar e confirme: "Let's meet at... See you then!".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar convites, aceitar e recusar, e as preposições de tempo.
prompts: Invite me to do something next week.
How do you say no politely?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Vamos tomar um café amanhã?"
accepted: Shall we have a coffee tomorrow?
Do you want to have a coffee tomorrow?
Would you like to have a coffee tomorrow?
Let's have a coffee tomorrow
How about a coffee tomorrow?
How about having a coffee tomorrow?
Do you want to get a coffee tomorrow?
Want to grab a coffee tomorrow?
Do you want to grab a coffee tomorrow?
Shall we get a coffee tomorrow?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tomar um café" é "have a coffee" (ou "get/grab a coffee"), e não "take a coffee".
commonErrors.correction_en: Shall we have a coffee tomorrow?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "let's" vem o verbo sem "to": "Let's have a coffee".
commonErrors.correction_en: Let's have a coffee tomorrow.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Vamos...?" como convite é "Shall we...?" ou "Let's...".
commonErrors.correction_en: Shall we have a coffee tomorrow?

exercises.sentence: How about ___ to the beach on Sunday?
accepted: going

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "How about" o verbo leva "-ing": "How about going...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: How about going to the beach on Sunday?

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual é a recusa mais educada?
options: Thanks for asking, but I'm afraid I can't. Maybe another time?
exercises.explanation_pt: Agradecer, recusar com "I'm afraid I can't" e sugerir outra vez é o jeito educado. "Compromise" é falso cognato.

exercises.prompt: Sounds great! See you on Sunday, then.
accepted: Sounds great! See you on Sunday, then
Sounds great! See you on Sunday
That sounds great! See you on Sunday, then
